comments.author: count023
comments.body: if it's a serious game and not simply just a "making it for self gratification", one of your atsks with it shoudl be getting the AI to learn the warcraft 3 JASS implementation of game modes, missins, etc, and give your game the same level of scripting and modability that WC3 had. I've found the AI's really good at implementing these things, either as LUA or customer language if you have a reference line for what you intend, and its' easier to buildthis stuff in earl than to try to retrofit later.
